list_accounts.title: List my mail accounts
list_accounts.description: List every mail account of the signed-in user with its accountId, primary address, send-as addresses and settings. Call this first: nearly every other Zoho Mail tool needs an accountId.

output.description: The user's mail accounts.

get_account.title: Get a mail account
get_account.description: Read one mail account's details: addresses, display name, reply-to, forwarding, vacation reply and incoming/outgoing settings.

output.description: The account.

update_account_sequence.title: Reorder mail accounts
update_account_sequence.description: Set the order in which the user's mail accounts are listed, by passing every accountId in the desired sequence.

account_ids.description: All account ids in the desired order.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

update_reply_to_address.title: Set the reply-to address
update_reply_to_address.description: Change the reply-to address of a mail account. Zoho emails a verification link to the new address; use resend_reply_to_verification if it is lost.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

resend_reply_to_verification.title: Resend reply-to verification
resend_reply_to_verification.description: Resend the verification email for a mail account's pending reply-to address.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

add_send_mail_details.title: Add a send-as address
add_send_mail_details.description: Add a From (send-as) address to a mail account, either another Zoho mailbox (extmailbox) or an external address delivered through its own SMTP server (extfrom).

send_mail_details.description: Send-as entries: {fromAddress, displayName, mode: extmailbox|extfrom, serverName, serverPort, userName, password, smtpConnection}.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

update_display_name.title: Update display name
update_display_name.description: Change the display name shown on mail sent from an account.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

update_account_email_address.title: Update account email address
update_account_email_address.description: Change the email address used by a mail account (must be one the user owns, e.g. an alias).

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

update_display_name_and_email.title: Update display name and email
update_display_name_and_email.description: Change both the display name and the email address of a mail account in one call.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

add_email_forwarding.title: Add email forwarding
add_email_forwarding.description: Forward incoming mail of an account to one or more addresses. Each target must then be verified with verify_email_forwarding.

forward_to.description: Email addresses the forwarding rule concerns.

is_user_forward.description: True when the user (not an admin) set up the forward.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

verify_email_forwarding.title: Verify email forwarding
verify_email_forwarding.description: Confirm a forwarding address with the confirmation key Zoho emailed to it.

confirm_key.description: Confirmation key from the verification email.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

resend_forwarding_verification.title: Resend forwarding verification
resend_forwarding_verification.description: Resend the verification email for one or more pending forwarding addresses.

forward_to.description: Email addresses the forwarding rule concerns.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

enable_email_forwarding.title: Enable email forwarding
enable_email_forwarding.description: Turn forwarding back on for one or more verified forwarding addresses.

forward_to.description: Email addresses the forwarding rule concerns.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

disable_email_forwarding.title: Disable email forwarding
disable_email_forwarding.description: Pause forwarding to one or more addresses without removing them.

forward_to.description: Email addresses the forwarding rule concerns.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

set_forwarding_keep_copy.title: Keep or delete Zoho copy when forwarding
set_forwarding_keep_copy.description: Choose whether Zoho Mail deletes its own copy of mail it forwards (deleteCopy true) or keeps it (false).

delete_copy.description: True deletes the Zoho Mail copy after forwarding.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

remove_email_forwarding.title: Remove email forwarding
remove_email_forwarding.description: Delete one or more forwarding addresses from a mail account.

forward_to.description: Email addresses the forwarding rule concerns.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

add_vacation_reply.title: Add vacation auto-reply
add_vacation_reply.description: Set up an out-of-office auto-reply for a date range on a mail account.

sending_interval.description: Days between repeat auto-replies to the same sender (0 = every mail).

for_all_accounts.description: Apply to all the user's accounts.

name.description: A name for this vacation reply.

reply_for_to_mails.description: Reply only when the user is in the To field.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

update_vacation_reply.title: Update vacation auto-reply
update_vacation_reply.description: Change an existing vacation auto-reply (dates, text, audience). Get vacation_id from get_account.

sending_interval.description: Days between repeat auto-replies to the same sender (0 = every mail).

for_all_accounts.description: Apply to all the user's accounts.

name.description: A name for this vacation reply.

reply_for_to_mails.description: Reply only when the user is in the To field.

vacation_id.description: Id of the vacation reply to update.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

remove_vacation_reply.title: Remove vacation auto-reply
remove_vacation_reply.description: Delete the vacation auto-reply configured on a mail account.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

enable_external_account.title: Enable an external POP/IMAP account
enable_external_account.description: Re-enable fetching for an external POP or IMAP account that was added to the user's mailbox.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

disable_external_account.title: Disable an external POP/IMAP account
disable_external_account.description: Stop fetching mail from an external POP or IMAP account added to the user's mailbox.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

get_signatures.title: Get my signatures
get_signatures.description: List the signed-in user's email signatures, or one when id is given.

output.description: Signatures.

add_signature.title: Add a signature
add_signature.description: Create an email signature for the signed-in user and optionally assign it to addresses.

position.description: 0 places the signature below quoted text, 1 above.

assign_users.description: Comma-separated addresses to assign the signature to.

output.description: The created signature.

update_signature.title: Update a signature
update_signature.description: Edit one of the signed-in user's signatures: name, content, position or the addresses it is assigned to.

position.description: 0 places the signature below quoted text, 1 above.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

delete_signature.title: Delete a signature
delete_signature.description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's email signatures.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

list_folders.title: List folders
list_folders.description: List every folder in a mail account (Inbox, Sent, Drafts, custom folders) with folderId, path, unread and total counts. Folder ids are needed to read or delete messages.

output.description: Folders.

get_folder.title: Get a folder
get_folder.description: Read one folder's details: name, path, parent, IMAP visibility and message counts.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

output.description: The folder.

create_folder.title: Create a folder
create_folder.description: Create a mail folder, at the top level or under a parent folder.

parent_folder_path.description: Parent folder path, alternative to the id.

output.description: The new folder.

rename_folder.title: Rename a folder
rename_folder.description: Give a mail folder a new name. The folder id and its messages are unchanged.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

move_folder.title: Move a folder
move_folder.description: Move a folder under another parent folder, optionally after a given sibling.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

previous_folder_id.description: Sibling folder to place it after.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

enable_folder_imap.title: Show folder over IMAP
enable_folder_imap.description: Make a folder visible to IMAP clients, so desktop and mobile mail apps sync it.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

disable_folder_imap.title: Hide folder from IMAP
disable_folder_imap.description: Hide a folder from IMAP clients; it stays visible in Zoho Mail on the web.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

mark_folder_read.title: Mark folder as read
mark_folder_read.description: Mark every message in a folder as read in one call, instead of flagging messages one by one.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

empty_folder.title: Empty a folder
empty_folder.description: Delete every email in a folder. Irreversible for the folder's contents.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

delete_folder.title: Delete a folder
delete_folder.description: Delete a mail folder permanently. Use rename_folder instead to keep its contents under a new name.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

list_labels.title: List labels
list_labels.description: List the labels (tags) defined in a mail account, with labelId, name and colour.

output.description: Labels.

get_label.title: Get a label
get_label.description: Read one label's name, colour and id. Use list_labels to find label ids.

output.description: The label.

create_label.title: Create a label
create_label.description: Create a label that can be applied to emails and threads.

output.description: The new label.

update_label.title: Update a label
update_label.description: Rename a label or change its colour. Messages already tagged keep the label.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

delete_label.title: Delete a label
delete_label.description: Delete a label; emails carrying it are kept.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

send_email.title: Send an email
send_email.description: Send (or schedule) an email from a Zoho Mail account. To attach files, pass attachments returned by Zoho's upload-attachments endpoint. Use reply_to_email to answer an existing message.

from_address.description: Sender address; must belong to the account.

content.description: Body, HTML unless mail_format is plaintext.

is_schedule.description: True to schedule instead of sending now.

time_zone.description: Time zone for schedule_type 6, e.g. Asia/Calcutta.

schedule_time.description: Send time for schedule_type 6, MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS.

output.description: The sent message's details.

save_draft.title: Save a draft or template
save_draft.description: Save an email as a draft or a template without sending it. For a draft reply, set in_reply_to (and ref_header for threads).

from_address.description: Sender address; must belong to the account.

content.description: Body, HTML unless mail_format is plaintext.

in_reply_to.description: Message-ID header of the mail being replied to.

ref_header.description: Space-separated Message-IDs of earlier mails in the thread.

output.description: The saved draft.

reply_to_email.title: Reply to an email
reply_to_email.description: Reply to an existing message (or schedule the reply). Use send_email for a brand-new email.

from_address.description: Sender address; must belong to the account.

content.description: Body, HTML unless mail_format is plaintext.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

is_schedule.description: True to schedule instead of sending now.

time_zone.description: Time zone for schedule_type 6, e.g. Asia/Calcutta.

schedule_time.description: Send time for schedule_type 6, MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS.

output.description: The sent reply.

list_messages.title: List emails in a folder
list_messages.description: List emails in a folder (or across the account) with summary fields: messageId, folderId, threadId, sender, subject, summary, received time, flags. Filter by read status, flag, label, thread, attachments. Use search_messages for keyword search and get_message_content for the body.

folder_id.description: Folder to list; omit for all.

output.description: Message summaries.

search_messages.title: Search emails
search_messages.description: Search a mail account using Zoho's search syntax, e.g. 'subject:invoice', 'sender:ada@example.com', 'entire:report::has:attachment' or 'newMails'. Returns message summaries like list_messages.

received_time.description: Only mails received before this epoch-ms time.

output.description: Matching message summaries.

get_message_content.title: Get an email's body
get_message_content.description: Read the HTML body of an email. Optionally include quoted (blockquote) content.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

output.description: messageId and content.

get_message_headers.title: Get an email's headers
get_message_headers.description: Read the MIME headers of an email, raw or as JSON.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

raw.description: True (default) for raw text, false for JSON.

output.description: The headers.

get_message_details.title: Get an email's metadata
get_message_details.description: Read an email's metadata: sender, recipients, subject, sizes, flags, labels, times — without the body.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

output.description: Message metadata.

get_original_message.title: Get the original (raw) email
get_original_message.description: Download the full original MIME source (.eml text) of an email.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

output.description: Raw RFC 822 message.

get_attachment_info.title: List an email's attachments
get_attachment_info.description: List the attachments of an email (attachmentId, name, size), optionally including inline images.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

output.description: Attachment info.

download_attachment.title: Download an attachment
download_attachment.description: Download one attachment's file content. Get attachment_id from get_attachment_info.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

output.description: The file bytes.

download_inline_image.title: Download an inline image
download_inline_image.description: Download an image embedded inline in an email body, by its content id.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

output.description: The image bytes.

mark_messages_read.description: Mark one or more emails (or whole threads) as read.

thread_ids.description: Thread ids to act on (whole conversations) instead of message ids.

mark_messages_unread.title: Mark emails as unread
mark_messages_unread.description: Mark one or more emails (or whole threads) as unread.

thread_ids.description: Thread ids to act on (whole conversations) instead of message ids.

thread_ids.description: Thread ids to act on (whole conversations) instead of message ids.

is_folder_specific.description: Limit the action to messages in folder_id.

folder_id.description: Folder the action is limited to.

flag.description: Flag to set; flag_not_set clears it.

apply_labels_to_messages.title: Label emails
apply_labels_to_messages.description: Apply one or more labels to emails or threads.

is_folder_specific.description: Limit the action to messages in folder_id.

folder_id.description: Folder the action is limited to.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

remove_labels_from_messages.title: Remove labels from emails
remove_labels_from_messages.description: Remove specific labels from emails or threads.

thread_ids.description: Thread ids to act on (whole conversations) instead of message ids.

is_folder_specific.description: Limit the action to messages in folder_id.

folder_id.description: Folder the action is limited to.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

remove_all_labels_from_messages.title: Remove all labels from emails
remove_all_labels_from_messages.description: Strip every label from the given emails or threads.

thread_ids.description: Thread ids to act on (whole conversations) instead of message ids.

is_folder_specific.description: Limit the action to messages in folder_id.

folder_id.description: Folder the action is limited to.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

archive_messages.title: Archive emails
archive_messages.description: Archive emails (or whole threads) so they leave the folder view.

thread_ids.description: Thread ids to act on (whole conversations) instead of message ids.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

unarchive_messages.title: Unarchive emails
unarchive_messages.description: Bring archived emails (or threads) back into their folders.

thread_ids.description: Thread ids to act on (whole conversations) instead of message ids.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

is_folder_specific.description: Limit the action to messages in folder_id.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

mark_messages_not_spam.title: Mark emails as not spam
mark_messages_not_spam.description: Mark emails as not spam and restore them out of the Spam folder.

is_folder_specific.description: Limit the action to messages in folder_id.

folder_id.description: Folder the action is limited to.

output.description: A status object; code 200 means success.

delete_message.description: Move an email to Trash, or delete it permanently with expunge=true.

folder_id.description: Folder id from list_folders.

message_id.description: Message id from list_messages or search_messages.

expunge.description: Delete permanently instead of moving to Trash.

folder_id.description: Folder the action is limited to.

folder_id.description: Folder the action is limited to.

list_task_groups.title: List task groups
list_task_groups.description: List the groups the user belongs to that have group tasks; their zgid is needed for group task tools.

list_tasks_assigned_to_me.title: List tasks assigned to me

list_tasks_created_by_me.title: List tasks created by me
list_tasks_created_by_me.description: List tasks the signed-in user created, across personal and group lists.

list_task_group_members.description: List the members of a task group with their zuids, for assigning tasks.

recur_yearly_on_day_of_week_in_month.description: Week of month (1-4) for yearly recurrence.

update_personal_task_status.description: Rename or recolour a custom task status of the signed-in user's personal task list.
